validation.legalEntity: Choose the legal entity responsible for this program.

decimal.json-number: {field}: enter decimal text, not a JSON number.
decimal.separator: {field}: rewrite {value} without grouping separators, using a dot for decimals.
decimal.decimal-comma: {field}: rewrite {value} as {dotted}, using a dot for decimals.
decimal.ambiguous-comma: {field}: {value} could mean {grouped} or {dotted}. Retype the intended value with a dot for decimals and no grouping.
decimal.currency: {field}: remove the currency symbol {symbol}; enter the amount only.
decimal.scientific: {field}: write {value} in full decimal form, not scientific notation.

portfolio.description: Benefits manages employer programs and employee choices. Payroll manages pay, taxes and statutory deductions.

home.heroHint: Open a program to manage its rules, participants, activity and payroll connection.
home.payrollHint: Contribution elections become payroll deductions and employer contributions. Provider remittance is managed separately from employee payment.

portfolio.unknownType: Unknown program type “{type}”. Choose a type from the filter.

approvalControls.noneHint: Authorized submissions become ready for payroll. No workflow configuration or approver is required.

portfolio.awardCurrencyHint: Inherited from the selected program; payroll does not convert reward currency.

programPurpose.reward: Define recognition rules, participants and budget. Give rewards from the program and follow them in Delivery.
programPurpose.allowance: Define allowance amounts and participants. Record individual grants in the program and follow them in Delivery.
programPurpose.incentive: Define performance measurements and allocation rules. Simulate and settle periods in this program, then follow the results in Delivery.
programPurpose.custom: Define the benefit, participation and grant rules. Record employee grants in the program and follow them in Delivery.

portfolio.scopeHint: Benefits defines employer-sponsored offers and employee grants. Payroll manages salary, tax, statutory contributions and pay-run processing.

views.overview: Employer programs, employee participation and controlled delivery.
views.programs: Open a program to manage its rules, participants, activity and payroll connection.
views.enrolments: Enroll employees in coverage and savings plans. Manage enrollment periods through Enrollment windows.
views.rewards: Record employee recognition and benefit grants against an active program. Configure reusable offers in Programs.
views.incentives: Manage performance-based programs. Open a record to simulate, calculate and settle employee payouts.
views.payouts: Release ready grants to payroll and follow their delivery history. Create rewards in Rewards and settle measured programs in Incentives.
views.employees: View employee programs, coverage, elections and effective terms. Payroll applies the program rules.
views.delivery: Release ready rewards and settled incentives. Follow payroll processing and external fulfillment separately.
